component.name: NotePadLX
component.summary: Source code editor, a Linux port of Notepad++

description.p: NotePadLX brings Notepad++ to Linux as a native Qt 6 application, ported from the Notepad++ sources. It keeps the Notepad++ editing engine (Scintilla and Lexilla), its themes and its configuration files.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting and folding for more than 80 languages, plus user defined languages
Notepad++ themes, with Solarized as the default dark theme
Find and Replace, Find in Files, Mark, the Finder, regular expressions
Macro recording and playback, the Run menu
Function list, document map, document list, folder as workspace, project panels
Column editor, MD5 and SHA hashes, multi-selection and column mode

screenshot.caption: Editing C++ with the Solarized theme, the function list and the document map

description.p: First public version: the main window, files and sessions, search, languages and styling, the docking panels, macros, the Run menu, the column editor and the hash tools.
